corpus.raw_content: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) defines an open standard using JSON-RPC 2.0 to connect LLM host clients to modular tool servers. MCP servers expose three fundamental primitives: Prompts (templated workflows), Resources (read-only documents and data), and Tools (executable functions with JSON schemas).

corpus.page_title: Reciprocal Rank Fusion in Hybrid Search
corpus.raw_content: Reciprocal Rank Fusion calculates document relevance by summing reciprocal rank positions: RRF_Score(d) = sum(1 / (k + r_m(d))) across dense and BM25 systems. Using k=60 smooths steep drop-offs, ensuring documents appearing reasonably high in both retrieval modalities outscore outliers with high rank in only one modality.
